blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the President (OP) may receive a recommendation from the Department of Finance (DOF) this week regarding the status of suspension of excise tax of diesel and other fuel products, Bataan Rep. Albert Garcia said on Wednesday. During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations for the proposed budget of the OP next year, Gabriela party-list Rep. Sarah Elago asked Garcia why the current administration only suspended the excise tax for liquefied petroleum gas and kerosene, and not for diesel and other fuel products, amid the rising fuel prices due to the conflict in the Middle East.
